speaker: Doctor
text: I'm sorry to hear you're feeling this way. To better understand your condition, can you tell me if you've noticed any changes in your urine color or frequency since the sinusitis treatment started?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Has the flank pain been accompanied by burning during urination or the need to urinate very frequently?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Urine Culture.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis shows Leukocyturia Present; Bacterial Culture Negative; Cytospin Stained With Hansel's Solution reveals 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis secondary to Escherichia coli.
